## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem or gap you're running into — not the solution yet. E.g. "It's hard to find X during build season because Y."

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see added or changed.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why they didn't fit as well.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, similar features in other tools, how often you'd expect to use this.
